english.meaning: a lychee variety with small round fruit
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Yeah, but it’s not very big—not as big as a lychee. Anyway, it has a fairly large pit; the rest is medium-sized.
